answers.moment: When Joanne explained what a shift lead in a dementia home actually does. Medication rounds, care plans, but mainly watching all the time, e.g. someone not eating or walking differently, and noticing before the doctor does. I hadnt known she does twelve hour shifts and that the pottery class is where she goes to not think.
answers.reason: It was the first time she really opened up, she was a bit short before that. Also it sort of connected to my own work, spotting small problems early, though hers matters a lot more. It changed how I saw the bowls on the shelf
